usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ApplyFogLate=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ApplyFogLate <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When true, fog will be applied on cloud later in the frame. This applies fog on cloud without visible latency due to reprojection and reconstruction. It is a bit more expenssive (upsampling pass cost is roughly x2) but the only correct look when Lumen is enabled and tracing is run on async compute using r.VolumetricRenderTarget.PreferAsyncCompute=1.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ApplyFogLate.CloudOnTranslucent=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ApplyFogLate.CloudOnTranslucent <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When r.VolumetricCloud.ApplyFogLate=1, fog is not into the volumetric cloud reconstructed buffer. So when applied on translucent, a visual discrepancy can become visible for translucent behind clouds. This enables the reconstruction step to also output an extra cloud buffer with fog included for application on translucent. It is more expenssive and use more memory so it is disabled by default.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ApplyFogOnAllPixel=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ApplyFogOnAllPixel <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When true, fog will be applied on cloud tracing buffer on all pixels instead of only where clouds coverage is >0. This is a tiny bit more expenssive but can remove visual discontinuities when cloud coverage is close to or flip to 0.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.DisableCompute=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.DisableCompute <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Do not use compute shader for cloud tracing.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.DistanceToSampleMaxCount=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.DistanceToSampleMaxCount <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Distance in kilometers over which the total number of ray samples will be evenly distributed. Before that, the number of ray samples will span 1 to SampleCountMax, for for tracing distance ranging from 0 to DistanceToSampleCountMax (kilometers).

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.EmptySpaceSkipping=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.EmptySpaceSkipping <值>` 或 INI 中配置

help: The number of slices to bias the start depth with. A valuie of -1 means a bias of one slice towards the view point.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.EmptySpaceSkipping.VolumeDepth=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.EmptySpaceSkipping.VolumeDepth <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Set the distance in kilometer over which empty space can be evalauted.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.HighQualityAerialPerspective=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.HighQualityAerialPerspective <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable/disable a second pass to trace the aerial perspective per pixel on clouds instead of using the aerial persepctive texture. Only usable when r.VolumetricCloud.EnableAerialPerspectiveSampling=1 and only needed for extra quality when r.VolumetricRenderTarget=1.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.LocalLights.ShadowSampleCount=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.LocalLights.ShadowSampleCount <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: [EXPERIMENTAL] Set the volumetric shadow sample count when evaluating local lights. Expenssive! Use for cinematics if needed.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ReflectionRaySampleMaxCount=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ReflectionRaySampleMaxCount <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The maximum number of samples taken while ray marching primary rays in reflections.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.SampleClampCount=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.SampleClampCount <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: After the sample count for a trace has been evaluated, we can still clamp the sample count. This is useful to avoid long running GPU waves which can increase the cost, especially when started later on the async compute pipe. It should not be set too low otherwise the visual result will look incomplete. It is tied to all the sample count cvar, so it needs to be setup for all quality levels.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.SampleMinCount=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.SampleMinCount <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The minimum number of samples to take along a ray. This can help with quality for volume close to the camera, e.g. if cloud layer is also used as low altitude fog. SampleMinCount should remain relatively small because it is applied to all tracing process.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.Shadow.ReflectionRaySampleMaxCount=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.Shadow.ReflectionRaySampleMaxCount <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The maximum number of samples taken while ray marching shadow rays in reflections.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.Shadow.SampleAtmosphericLightShadowmap=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.Shadow.SampleAtmosphericLightShadowmap <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable the sampling of atmospheric lights shadow map in order to produce volumetric shadows.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.Shadow.ViewRaySampleMaxCount=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.Shadow.ViewRaySampleMaxCount <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The maximum number of samples taken while ray marching shadow rays.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap <值>` 或 INI 中配置

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.Debug=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.Debug <值>` 或 INI 中配置

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.MaxResolution=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.MaxResolution <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: The maximum resolution of the cloud shadow map. The active resolution is controlled by the CloudShadowMapResolutionScale property on the Directional Light component.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.RaySampleHorizonMultiplier=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.RaySampleHorizonMultiplier <值>` 或 INI 中配置

help: The maximum number of samples taken while ray marching shadow rays to evaluate the cloud shadow map.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.SnapLength=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.SnapLength <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Snapping size in kilometers of the cloud shadowmap position to avoid flickering.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.SnapToPixelGrid=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.SnapToPixelGrid <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Snaps world origin to the shadow map pixel grid. Avoids shimmering with camera movement when r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.SnapLength is small.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.SpatialFiltering=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.SpatialFiltering <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable/disable the shadow map dilation/smoothing spatial filter. Enabled when greater than 0 and it represents the number of blur iterations (constrained to a maximum of 4).

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.TemporalFiltering.LightRotationCutHistory=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.ShadowMap.TemporalFiltering.LightRotationCutHistory <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: When the atmospheric light rotation in degree is larger than that, the temporal accumulation is restarted.

help: Experimental and needs more work so disabled by default. Value between [0.0, 1.0] representing the weight of current frame's contribution. Low values can cause precision issues resulting in depth not converging over time. Disabled when set to 1.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.SkyAO.Debug=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.SkyAO.Debug <值>` 或 INI 中配置

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.SkyAO.Filtering=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.SkyAO.Filtering <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enable/disable the sky AO dilation/smoothing filter.

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.SkyAO.MaxResolution=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.SkyAO.MaxResolution <值>` 或 INI 中配置

usage: `r.VolumetricCloud.Support=<值>` / `r.VolumetricCloud.Support <值>` 或 INI 中配置

help: The maximum number of samples taken while ray marching view primary rays.

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.ConservativeDepth=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.ConservativeDepth <值>` 或 INI 中配置

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.DepthDistributionScale=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.DepthDistributionScale <值>` 或 INI 中配置

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.Emissive=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.Emissive <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to allow the volumetric fog emissive component.

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.Filtering.Quality=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.Filtering.Quality <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: 0: Trilinear\n

help: Offset in grid units to move grid center sample out form the depth buffer along the Z direction. -1 means disabled. This reduces sample self intersection with geometry when tracing, and thus reduces flickering in those areas, as well as results in less leaking sometimes. Set to -1 to disable.

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.GridPixelSize=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.GridPixelSize <值>` 或 INI 中配置

help: Scales the amount added to the inverse squared falloff denominator.  This effectively removes the spike from inverse squared falloff that causes extreme aliasing.

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.Jitter=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.Jitter <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to apply jitter to each frame's volumetric fog computation, achieving temporal super sampling.

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.LightFunction=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.LightFunction <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: This is an alias, please use r.VolumetricFog.UsesLightFunctionAtlas.

help: Multiplier for random offset value used to jitter each world sample position when generating the 3D fog volume. Enable/disable with r.VolumetricFog.Jitter

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.LightSoftFading=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.LightSoftFading <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Enabled when >0, controls the soft fading of spot and rect light edges in order to make them appear smoother, resulting in less flickering. A value of 1 is a good starting point and it means that fading will be applied over the size of 1 froxel on the screen.

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.OffsetThresholdToAcceptDepthBufferOffset=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.OffsetThresholdToAcceptDepthBufferOffset <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Offset in grid units to accept a sample to be moved forward in front of the depth buffer. This is to avoid moving all samples behind the depth buffer forward which would affect the lighting of translucent and volumetric at edges of mesh. Default to 1.0 to only allow moving the first layer of froxel intersecting depth.

usage: `r.VolumetricFog.RectLightTexture=<值>` / `r.VolumetricFog.RectLightTexture <值>` 或 INI 中配置
help: Whether to allow the volumetric fog to use rect light source texture.
